evals.prompt: /runner plans/login-frontend.plan.md 진입 후 새 plan을 처음부터 끝까지 실행해줘. plan은 3개 phase로 구성돼 있어.
evals.expected_output: Bootstrap 컨텍스트 인식, 디스크+phase 라우팅, worktree 생성, 단일 Agent 디스패치, dev-review 통과 후 사용자에게 병합 옵션 제시
expectations: Reads SKILL.md via Read tool when needed
Recognizes the [runner-skill bootstrap] context block emitted by UserPromptSubmit
Reads state JSON at plans/{plan_key}/.runner-state.json before acting
Infers Step 2 (create worktree) from absent worktree + dev_review.phase=null
Creates exactly one git worktree at state.worktree_path
Dispatches exactly one Agent call with subagent_type = state.owner_agent (foreground)
Invokes dev-review skill in the same turn after the plan agent returns
Removes the worktree only after dev-review returns approved
Keeps HEAD on state.base_branch throughout the run
Creates plans/{plan_key}/.merged after the user picks the merge option

evals.prompt: /runner plans/login-frontend.plan.md 다시 입력. 이전에 dev-review에서 needs-change 2건이 나와서 멈췄어. state.dev_review.phase는 'rework'이고 last_feedback_path도 state에 있어.
evals.expected_output: feedback.json에서 rework_items[] 읽고 commit별로 reviewer가 지정한 dispatch_agent로 Agent를 디스패치, 완료 후 rework-done CLI 호출 + dev-review 재진입
expectations: Recognizes dev_review.phase=rework from the state JSON
Reads last_feedback_path and parses rework_items[]
Dispatches one Agent call per rework_item using item.dispatch_agent (not the plan owner_agent)
Each rework dispatch is foreground
Calls runner-state-cli rework-done after all rework agents finish
Re-invokes dev-review skill so the package regenerates against the new HEAD
Does NOT delete the worktree at this stage

evals.prompt: /runner plans/login-frontend.plan.md 진입. 이미 머지된 plan이라 .merged 마커가 있어. 어떻게 처리해?
evals.expected_output: UserPromptSubmit hook이 .merged 마커를 감지하고 decision: block + 한국어 안내를 emit. skill은 도달하지 않음.
expectations: UserPromptSubmit hook reads plans/{plan_key}/.merged before creating state
If marker exists, hook emits decision: block with Korean instructions
The runner skill never enters this turn

evals.prompt: /runner를 입력했는데 plan 경로 인자가 없어. 어떻게 처리해?
evals.expected_output: UserPromptSubmit hook이 차단해서 skill에는 도달하지 않거나, 도달했어도 bootstrap 부재를 인식하고 사용자에게 안내
expectations: Either does not run (hook blocked) or detects missing bootstrap and asks the user to re-invoke /runner with a plan path
Does NOT try to validate plan files manually
Does NOT create a worktree without a state file
